## 5. Unavailed JT to be credited to the EL  
The period of unutilized joining time shall be regulated in terms of the provisions of sub-clause (ii) of Clause (a) of sub-rule (1) of Rule 26 of the Central Civil Service (Leave) Rules, 1972. - Rule 6 (1).
